title: State loneliness is associated with emotional hypervigilance in daily life: A network analysis
network_types: temporal network, contemporaneous network, between-subject network
limitations: - Participants were not screened for neurological or psychiatric disorders; - Limited number of variables used; - Did not measure social interactions and contexts; - Stationary assumption for multi-level VAR modeling may not hold; - Observational data limits causal interpretation.
notes: The paper does not mention preregistration. Code and data availability are not explicitly stated in the main text, but supplementary materials may contain this information. The authors used R and mlVAR for analysis, and visualizations were likely created using qgraph.
